# U.S. Core Inflation Rate (Year-over-Year), Jan 2015 – Dec 2016

Core CPI excludes food and energy prices. Data is sourced from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS).

| Month | YoY Core CPI (%) |
|-------------|------------------|
| Jan 2015 | 1.6 |
| Feb 2015 | 1.7 |
| Mar 2015 | 1.8 |
| Apr 2015 | 1.8 |
| May 2015 | 1.7 |
| Jun 2015 | 1.8 |
| Jul 2015 | 1.8 |
| Aug 2015 | 1.8 |
| Sep 2015 | 1.9 |
| Oct 2015 | 1.9 |
| Nov 2015 | 2.0 |
| Dec 2015 | 2.1 |
| Jan 2016 | 2.2 |
| Feb 2016 | 2.3 |
| Mar 2016 | 2.2 |
| Apr 2016 | 2.1 |
| May 2016 | 2.2 |
| Jun 2016 | 2.3 |
| Jul 2016 | 2.2 |
| Aug 2016 | 2.3 |
| Sep 2016 | 2.2 |
| Oct 2016 | 2.1 |
| Nov 2016 | 2.1 |
| Dec 2016 | 2.2 |

### Key Observations
- **Steady upward trend in 2015:** Core inflation gradually rose from 1.6% in January to 2.1% by December 2015.
- **Stable around 2% in 2016:** Throughout 2016, core inflation hovered between 2.1% and 2.3%, consistently above the Federal Reserve's 2% target.
- **Peak:** The highest point in this period was 2.3%, reached in February, June, and August 2016.
